title: Baby Potatoes with Indian Spice
description: A flavorful and spicy dish made with baby potatoes, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of Indian spices and herbs adds a unique twist to this simple recipe.

ingredients.name: light oil
ingredients.notes: such as canola or vegetable oil

instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
3. Add diced new potatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add baby potatoes, gulab powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, and turmeric powder. Mix well.
5. Add salt to taste and mix again.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through.
